decisions.diagnosis: One channel reported a corrupt 255 (0xFF) value in the 15:00 slot, inflating the day's total.
decisions.evidence: Slot 60 records 0,255,2,0; day total 494 vs ~266 on neighbouring Wednesdays and 305 in SW the same day; hour 15 = 265 vs ~10 normally.

decisions.diagnosis: Phantom counts in both directions around the clock (sensor fault), not bikes.
decisions.evidence: 00-05h counts 210/110 (SW/NE) on 30 Apr, 293/105 on 1 May, 171/79 on 2 May vs 0-5 normally; single channel records of 30-101 per slot at 01:30-02:00; SW 961 and 849 on a weekend vs ~130 median; SW evening 130 on 29 Apr vs ~8.

decisions.diagnosis: NE sensor largely failed; it recorded a small, flat trickle while SW counted normally, and zero_outage only removed the ends of the run.
decisions.evidence: NE 7-31/day (weekday median ~240) with no commuter peaks (8am hour 0.7 vs 21 normally), SW 170-220 on weekdays; NE/SW weekly ratio 0.10-0.12 vs 1.1-1.2 historically; clean kept 2018-06-27..07-17.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter outage on a weekday; the NE side was already set missing by zero_outage but SW was kept.
decisions.evidence: SW 5 bikes all at 03:00-04:59, NE 1; neighbouring weekdays 150-176 SW.

decisions.diagnosis: Whole-day zero in both directions is an outage; NE was set missing but SW zeros were kept.
decisions.evidence: Raw 0 in both directions for the full Sunday; Sunday median ~111 SW.

decisions.diagnosis: Low counts during the ex-TC Oswald storm / Australia Day long weekend are real; both directions show the same low, scattered pattern, but only NE was removed.
decisions.evidence: NE raw 13 and 16 on 27-28 Jan vs SW 21 and 13 (kept); bikes spread over the day at 1-4 per hour in both directions.

decisions.diagnosis: Low counts on a wet Friday-Sunday are real; both directions fell together but only SW was removed.
decisions.evidence: SW raw 28/9/92 vs NE 25/13/126 (kept); commuter-hour bikes present in both on 22 May.

decisions.diagnosis: Very low weekend counts during the June 2016 East Coast Low storm are real; both directions show them but only SW was removed.
decisions.evidence: SW raw 10 and 7 on 4-5 Jun vs NE 19 and 4 (kept); scattered 1-3 bikes per hour through the day in both.

decisions.diagnosis: Very low counts that may be wet weather or a partial NE fault; NE was set missing and SW kept, so the directions are treated inconsistently.
decisions.evidence: NE raw 6/0/0/6 on 19-22 Jun (Fri-Mon), SW 12/7/5/20 with commuter-hour bikes; 17 Jun was already low (24/40), and on 23 Jun NE was 41 against SW 97.

decisions.diagnosis: SW data from the short reactivations in mid-2018 and June 2019 look plausible, but NE had failed then, so they cannot be checked against the other direction.
decisions.evidence: SW weekdays 170-240 and the hourly profile is like 2016 (8am peak 33-36); SW July 2018 averaged 169/day vs 117 in July 2016 and 180 in July 2020.

summary: A single piezo counter (Bourke Rd, Alexandria), with good data from Jul 2012 to Nov 2016 and from Mar 2020 to Jul 2021, and dead or garbage (bit-pattern values such as 255 and 4095) in between and after; the automatic fixes remove nearly all of the dead periods. The remaining faults are a phantom-count episode in both directions (29 Apr-2 May 2016), a corrupt 255 channel value on 4 Feb 2015, and a failed NE sensor in mid-2018 that still recorded a trickle; I also flagged a few storm days where zero_outage removed only one direction. There is one counter and no other site, so no series needs defining.
